tasks.gr8-making-and-evaluating-prototypes-t3: Topic: Making and evaluating prototypes. Cover prototyping, accurate measuring, joining methods, safe tool use, testing, and evaluation criteria. Ask Grade 8 learners to sequence making steps, choose suitable tools and joints, and judge prototype quality with evidence-based improvements.
tasks.gr8-simple-machines-revision-t3: Topic: Simple machines revision. Cover levers, inclined planes, wedges, wheel and axle systems, and force multiplication in daily life devices. Ask Grade 8 learners to identify machine types, explain reduced effort, and connect mechanism choice to a practical task.
tasks.gr8-gear-systems-mechanical-advantage-t3: Topic: Gear systems and mechanical advantage. Cover spur gears and counter-rotation, an idler gear (the driven gear turns the same way as the driver; the idler is of a harder material), bevel gears turning the axis through 90°, velocity ratio = driver teeth ÷ driven teeth, mechanical advantage = driven teeth ÷ driver teeth (or diameters), the trade-off (if force increases, speed decreases), calculations of output speed and output force, and design targets (force 3 times bigger: 10 and 30 teeth; speed 4 times bigger: 40 and 10 teeth). Do not use taking moments. Ask Grade 8 learners to calculate with teeth ratios and to choose gear pairs.
tasks.gr8-bicycle-gears-systems-diagrams-t3: Topic: Bicycle gears and systems diagrams. Cover the bicycle gear system (the chain wheel as driver or master, the cogs as driven or slave, the chain), wheel turns per pedal turn = chain wheel teeth ÷ cog teeth, high and low gears and when to use them, and a systems diagram as input, process and output for a gear system (MA = 4: 12 and 48 teeth; a driven gear that rotates faster than the driver). Ask Grade 8 learners to calculate gear ratios, choose gears and complete systems diagrams.
tasks.gr8-mining-technology-impact-bias-t3: Topic: Mining technology, impact and bias. Cover mining in every province (gold in Gauteng and the Free State, coal in Mpumalanga and KwaZulu-Natal, platinum in Limpopo and North West, iron and copper in the Northern Cape and Limpopo), the environmental impacts of acid mine drainage and dust pollution from mine dumps with causes, effects and solutions, Iron Age indigenous iron mining and smelting (furnaces, charcoal, clay pipes), and gender bias in mining careers. Do not quote statistics. Ask Grade 8 learners to investigate causes, effects and solutions and to identify bias.
